name: Solarise
summary: A home solar installer website: savings calculator, packages, financing, installs, reviews and survey booking
about: A ten-page website for a rooftop solar installer, in dawn orange and deep sky blue. On the home page the sun arcs across the sky as you scroll and the roof panels of the house light up one by one, while a live strip shows what the roof is making. The savings calculator sizes a system from your bill and city, then counts the savings up month by month; packages, financing, installs, reviews, FAQ and a four-step survey booking all work.
how: Scroll the home page to move the sun across the sky and light the roof panels; change the bill in the bar at the bottom
Open Savings: set the bill, city, roof, battery and shade, then watch the first year count up month by month and save the estimate
Switch packages between on-grid and hybrid or monthly prices, then choose one to add extras in the drawer
Try the financing plans, down payment and months, tick off the papers you have and run the eligibility check
Filter installs by city and type, open one for its bills and monthly output, and filter, sort or write reviews
Book a survey in four steps with a day and time picker, then cancel it from Your bookings
Press Ctrl+K to search pages, installs and answers; reset demo data from the footer
